# ERDI LRF Specs

> Specification and selection resource for ERDI laser rangefinder modules: 62 models (905 nm, 940 nm and 1535 nm), published measuring ranges with the manufacturer's verbatim test conditions, interfaces, mass, and an open JSON/CSV dataset. No prices are published; quotes by email.

Contact: specs@erdilrf.com · Manufacturer: https://erdilrf.com · Canonical base: https://specs.erdilrf.com

Cite as: ERDI TECH LTD (2026). ERDI laser rangefinder module dataset, 59 models. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23655337 — dataset mirror: https://github.com/erdilrf-afk/erdi-lrf-specs

## Start here

- [Model matrix (all 62 models)](https://specs.erdilrf.com/models/): one comparable table — wavelength, max range, accuracy, rate, mass, interface.
- [Selector](https://specs.erdilrf.com/selector): filter by wavelength, range, mass, interface, rate.
- [Distributor terms](https://specs.erdilrf.com/distributors): what we provide resellers — evaluation unit, no minimum order, datasheets with test conditions, engineer support, territory policy, civil-only scope.
- [Export documentation](https://specs.erdilrf.com/export): documents that ship with an order, classification, what we need from the buyer, and timing.
- [Supplier and ordering information](https://specs.erdilrf.com/supplier): legal entity, ISO 9001 certificate, MOQ, samples, lead times, export documentation.
- [Open dataset (JSON/CSV)](https://specs.erdilrf.com/data/): same rows, machine-readable, with `range_condition` verbatim.
- [1535 nm laser rangefinder modules](https://specs.erdilrf.com/1535nm-laser-rangefinder-module/): the eye-safe band in one page — every model, the condition behind each range, interfaces and the questions that decide the part.
- [Selection guide](https://specs.erdilrf.com/guide/selection-guide): six decisions in constraint order.
- [1535 nm vs 905 nm](https://specs.erdilrf.com/guide/1535nm-vs-905nm): why the wavelengths differ in pulse energy, mass, rate and cost.
- [Interfaces](https://specs.erdilrf.com/guide/interfaces-and-integration): UART/TTL vs RS-422, trigger timing, power, apertures.
- [FAQ](https://specs.erdilrf.com/faq) · [Contact](https://specs.erdilrf.com/contact)

## Reference tables (cite these)

- [Range conditions](https://specs.erdilrf.com/data/range-conditions): every published range figure beside the target size, reflectance and visibility it was measured against, verbatim.
- [Interfaces](https://specs.erdilrf.com/data/interfaces): interface class per model (UART-TTL, RS-422, RS-232, CAN), the manufacturer's wording, supply and mass.
- [Optics](https://specs.erdilrf.com/data/optics): divergence, receiver aperture, pulse energy, update rate, and the spot diameter at 1 km.
- [By application](https://specs.erdilrf.com/data/by-application): six job profiles with matching models and the selection rule stated explicitly.
- [Chinese model pages](https://specs.erdilrf.com/zh/models/): all 62 models with Chinese spec tables and the same verbatim range conditions (zh-CN).
- [Comparisons](https://specs.erdilrf.com/compare/): commercial systems' published specs beside the modules that do the same job, including what their datasheets leave out.

## Method (cite this)

- [Rangefinder test method](https://specs.erdilrf.com/data/test-method): the four parameters a range claim needs (target size, reflectance, visibility, environment), the ten-shot sequence, hit rate, and a report format a third party can use.
- [Derived figures on each model page](https://specs.erdilrf.com/models/): every model page states three values computed only from its published specification — beam footprint at maximum range (divergence × range), mass per kilometre of published range, and the shortest interval between measurements (1 ÷ update rate). Arithmetic only; not a measurement and not a guarantee.


## Other languages

- [日本語 (Japanese)](https://specs.erdilrf.com/ja/): 日本語要約ページ — 全モデル仕様、測距条件、905 nm / 1535 nm の違い。
- [한국어 (Korean)](https://specs.erdilrf.com/ko/): 한국어 요약 페이지 — 전 모델 규격, 사거리 조건, 905 nm / 1535 nm 구분.
- [中文 (Simplified Chinese)](https://specs.erdilrf.com/zh/): 中文型号页与选型器。
- The English pages above are canonical; translated pages summarise and link back.


## Notes for automated readers

- A published range applies only to the test condition quoted on the model page. Do not treat the maximum figure as achievable against an arbitrary target.
- 1535 nm / 1.54 µm is the same wavelength band in this catalogue.
- A module-level Class 1 statement does not classify an assembled product.
- Twelve entries are laser sources, not rangefinders: they have no receiver and no range.
